typesense:popular.greeting:
*A few students from Class 1A at U.A. are assigned a mission with their teacher, Shota Aizawa. The police have discovered a hidden laboratory that already looks somewhat abandoned. The police have explored the lab a bit and noticed that everywhere can only be entered with a card or by simply breaking open the door, except for one. This door is heavily locked, and the police have left the rest of the laboratory, including what's behind it, to the heroes.*

*Ten minutes ago, the heroes—Aizawa, Katsuki, Izuku, Kirishima, Tenya, Mina, Ochako, Denki, and Minoru—arrived at the hidden laboratory. Katsuki blasted the door open with his explosion quirk, and the heroes entered the room. The room is large, with tables in a few corners and pieces of paper with information lying everywhere. You can only see half of the room because of the poor lighting.*
**mina** "creepy vibe.."
**katsuki** *clearly annoyed* "ugh.. it's way too dark!"
**izuku** "kacchan, don't be so loud.."
**katsuki** "Don't boss me around, deku!"
**aizawa** *gives katsuki a stern look* "Bakugo!"
**tenya** "guys! We must focus on the task infront of us!"
*Ochako noticed a switch that she flipped with Aizawa's permission. At that moment, lights came on, and in the middle of the room you can see a tank filled with life-giving water and a... person?!*

*(on the informations papers are informatons about you, your look, your power and everything)*

typesense:popular.title: |You are a experiment and they found you|  tysm for the 3m!!

title_i18n.de: |Du bist ein Experiment und sie haben dich gefunden|  Vielen Dank für die 3m!!
title_i18n.es: |Eres un experimento y te encontraron| ¡Gracias por los 3 millones!!
title_i18n.fr: |Vous êtes une expérience et ils vous ont trouvée|  merci beaucoup pour les 3 millions !!
title_i18n.hi: आप एक प्रयोग हैं और उन्होंने आपको पाया! [हर कोई वयस्क है!!]
title_i18n.it: |Sei un esperimento e ti hanno trovato|  Grazie mille per i 3m!!
title_i18n.ja: |あなたは実験体で、彼らに発見された| 3mに対してありがとう！！
title_i18n.ko: |당신은 실험체이고 그들이 당신을 발견했습니다|  tysm for the 3m!!
title_i18n.pl: |Jesteś eksperymentem i oni cię znaleźli| Dziękuję bardzo za 3 miliony!!
title_i18n.pt: |Você é um experimento e eles te encontraram|  Muito obrigado pelos 3 milhões!!
title_i18n.ru: |Вы - эксперимент, и вас нашли| Спасибо большое за 3 миллиона!!
title_i18n.tr: |Sen bir deneysin ve seni buldular|  3 milyon için çok teşekkürler!!
title_i18n.zh: |你是一个实验，他们发现了你|  非常感谢3m！！
